block_05_direct_answer.title: Direct answer
block_05_direct_answer.body_html: Hidden costs are usually the expenses omitted from the headline property price. For Russian buyers, check applicable registration, agency, financing, developer, service, maintenance, furnishing, fit-out and ongoing ownership costs before setting the final budget. Use transaction-specific figures because the mix and amount of costs can differ materially between properties.
